articles.title: Jobs Report: Unemployment Rate Drops Despite Soft Hiring (Live Coverage)
articles.mainIdea: Jobs Report: Unemployment Rate Drops Despite Soft Hiring (Live Coverage)
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Jobs Report: Unemployment Rate Drops Despite Soft Hiring (Live Coverage). The December jobs report showed soft private-sector hiring, but the unemployment rate dropped from November's four-year high. S&P 500 futures slightly added to slim gains after the data as Wall Street weighed the implications for Federal Reserve rate cuts. Stocks got an early lift thanks to stronger-than-expected December revenue growth for Taiwan Semiconductor and Meta Platforms' power agreements with Vistra and Oklo. Related tickers mentioned: META, OKLO, VST, ^GSPC.

articles.title: BofA lifts platinum and palladium forecasts as PGM rally extends into 2026
articles.mainIdea: BofA lifts platinum and palladium forecasts as PGM rally extends into 2026
articles.summary: Investing.com: BofA lifts platinum and palladium forecasts as PGM rally extends into 2026. Investing.com -- Bank of America has raised its 2026 price forecasts for platinum and palladium after both metals surged beyond prior expectations, citing ongoing market deficits, U.S. tariff risks and strengthening Chinese demand. Related tickers mentioned: PA=F, PL=F.
